summary: Validated the latest main source on a single feature branch. Existing provider-protocol, fallback, cancellation, telemetry, package, built-artifact, benchmark, and deterministic rc.1 host/browser checks pass without source changes. Remaining partials are the unavailable published package/install path, unavailable authorized real-provider credential check, and feature-branch CI/PR evidence not available until a PR is opened. The exact eight-image host acceptance required an explicit task-owned maxImagesPerMessage=8 setting because the unconfigured rc.1 default is 20.
